scope: Target-owned photo/PDF product path as governed image engineering: bounded PNG/JPEG/PDF source decoding, EXIF/alpha normalization, bounded PDF rasterization, mandatory bound preflight for every external image input, explicit verified quadrilateral perspective rectification, bounded automatic perspective-corner detection from observable dark grid/paper support, bounded continuous deskew with deterministic post-transform crop, digitization-qualified 90-degree orientation search, ROI localization and standard-layout discovery, strict bitmap-template lead-label identity verification for supported printed labels, bounded trace-derived baseline verification, grid calibration, bounded sparse-column digitization, measurement gating, atomic content-addressed case persistence with replayable geometry and temporal-window provenance, immutable digitized extraction generations, canonical per-lead measurement/rhythm/phenotype analysis, whole-record cross-lead aggregation, temporally scoped same-window paper-panel comparison, and immutable analysis generations bound to exact extractions and preflight permissions.
registryNote: ECG-CAP-IMAGE-ROI-LOCALIZATION, ECG-CAP-IMAGE-GRID-CALIBRATION, and ECG-CAP-IMAGE-DIGITIZATION remain RESEARCH_REFERENCE in the frozen realization checkpoint so historical readiness counts stay exact. Executable code exists independently of that promotion.

proofBoundary.pngSupportedSubset: 8-bit non-interlaced grayscale, RGB, and RGBA; RGBA is composited over white; tRNS and unsupported critical chunks fail closed
proofBoundary.externalInputPreflightNote: Every non-synthetic image intake requires a validated preflight receipt bound to source kind, transport format, raster dimensions, and any explicit paper speed/gain. Resulting analysis permissions are content-addressed into immutable extraction generations and enforced during later signal analysis.
proofBoundary.externalRoiLeadIdentityNote: Supplying ROIs is not itself treated as lead-identity proof. External named-lead measurement/analysis and twelve-lead claims require roiLeadIdentityVerified=true in addition to a preflight that permits specific-lead claims.
proofBoundary.perspectiveCorrectionNote: Perspective correction remains a separate unfinished geometry gate; continuous deskew does not establish projective rectification.
proofBoundary.automaticPerspectiveCornerDetectionNote: Automatic detection is engineering-verified only when the paper/grid boundary is observable in raster support and passes convex-area plus edge-support gates. It is not evidence of reliable corner detection on arbitrary phone photos, cluttered backgrounds, glare, occlusion, or weak paper/background contrast.
proofBoundary.automaticPerspectiveGeneratedJpegNote: A generated trapezoid ECG encoded as real JPEG is decoded through the pinned native decoder, automatically corner-detected, rectified, deskewed, layout-discovered, digitized, and persisted without supplied ROIs. This remains generated-fixture engineering evidence, not clinical-photo validation.
proofBoundary.leadIdentityVerificationNote: Named-lead permissions can be unlocked only when supported printed lead labels match the strict bitmap-template verifier or when supplied ROI identity is explicitly attested. The verifier is engineering-scoped to supported templates and generated JPEG evidence; it is not general OCR and does not establish robustness to arbitrary fonts, handwriting, clipped labels, glare, blur, or real clinical photos. Successful identity verification does not make voltage calibration/baseline exact.
proofBoundary.traceBaselineVerificationNote: A discovered ROI baseline remains non-authoritative when it is only the 55-percent geometry assumption. Voltage permission can be granted only when every lead has an explicit ROI baseline or a trace-derived baseline receipt that passes bounded dominant-row/inlier-support gates, with explicit gain and trustworthy grid scale. Current positive evidence is synthetic/generated-JPEG engineering evidence; it does not establish baseline or voltage accuracy on real clinical photos, sustained ST shifts, pacing artifacts, noise, handwriting, glare, or other acquisition conditions.
proofBoundary.simultaneousLeadComparisonNote: The image path does not treat the full 12-lead print as one simultaneous 10-second block. Standard 3x4 panel metadata is preserved into immutable extraction. Whole-record cross-lead summaries use one canonical analysis per lead, preferring the 10-second lead-II rhythm strip. Same-window comparison separately analyzes the noncanonical 2.5-second panel-II trace as supplemental evidence, so the 0-2.5 s group is I/II/III while the rhythm-strip II is excluded from simultaneous grouping. Supplemental panel traces are source-bound and fully accounted during immutable analysis validation.
